tagline: Turn cURL commands into idiomatic Go — stdlib net/http or go-resty/resty/v2
pageDescription: Free cURL to Go converter transforms cURL commands into production-ready Go using the standard library net/http package or github.com/go-resty/resty/v2. Emits context.Background with timeout, http.NewRequestWithContext, defer resp.Body.Close(), and proper error propagation via if err != nil. Perfect for Go developers translating API documentation, Postman requests, or Chrome DevTools exports into gofmt-clean code. Browser-based conversion means your cURL command never leaves your device.

proTips: Prefer net/http in libraries to avoid forcing dependencies downstream
Use Resty in application code for readable fluent calls
Always propagate context — enables graceful cancellation
Run gofmt on generated code before committing
Disable InsecureSkipVerify only in dev — never in production
troubleshooting: Import cycle: keep HTTP client initialization in main or a dedicated package
context deadline exceeded: increase timeout or profile slow upstream
TLS cert errors: verify CA bundle or use a trusted HTTPS endpoint
Body not sent: ensure payload is passed as io.Reader (bytes.NewBuffer or strings.NewReader)
Resty import not found: run 'go get github.com/go-resty/resty/v2'
